title: Unacademy Cofounders Plan ₹700 Cr AI, Deeptech Fund
script:
Seven hundred crore rupees. That is Unacademy cofounders Gaurav Munjal and Roman Saini's brand new venture capital fund.
Called Longshot Capital, the new venture vehicle targets a total corpus of seventy million dollars.
The fund is set to invest in early stage startups building software and technological infrastructure.
Both founders join a growing wave of Indian tech operators launching dedicated investment firms.
Would you pitch your startup to them?
